<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that, in the forward direction, breaks a ketone and an alkyne (C‑C triple bond) and forms a new C‑C bond while breaking a C‑O bond, which matches the description of the cycloaddition that could give the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkyne"],
  "functional_groups_formed": null,
  "bonds_formed": null,
  "bonds_broken": null,
  "bonds_order_changed": null,
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
